name: plate-60-coupon-02
version_tag: FIRST 0.2 NOZZLE PLATE — tolerance coupon. 113_post_tolerance_coupon_v16 solo at [128,128]. PURPOSE: derive the 0.2's own dimensional constants. CRITICAL, AND THE EASIEST THING TO GET WRONG: xy_contour_compensation is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The -0.06 value belongs to the 0.4 nozzle and inheriting it would corrupt the very measurement this plate exists to make. Nothing else 0.4-derived is carried either. CROSS-VINTAGE: per Ron's strategy (a), new 0.2 parts must fit EXISTING 0.4-printed hardware, so read this coupon as 'what does a 0.2 part need to be to mate with 0.4 parts', not as the 0.2 in isolation. Finding #113 ran the same coupon on the 0.4 (plate-22, 2026-07-29): post ladder r2.50/2.55/2.60/2.65 against a r2.70 bore. Compare like for like. PROFILE NOTE: Bambu ships NO PLA profile for the P1S at 0.2 — only PC. This uses the X1C 0.2 filament preset, matching the repo's long-standing pattern of X1C-named processes on a P1S machine.
